title: Give sync_status_emission_test.dart's 'empty outbox + online + after pull → synced' test actual assertions

evidence.quote: test('empty outbox + online + after pull → synced', () async {
// No assertion here — pre-pull, status remains whatever the failed

why: The test's name and the file's own header matrix both promise to verify the 'synced' cell (empty outbox + online + a completed pull), but the body ends after recordDrainAttempt() with a comment admitting no assertion is made, because _EmptyGateway cannot simulate a successful pull (every real fetch throws via noSuchMethod). The test always passes regardless of whether synced emission is broken for this exact scenario — it is pure green-checkmark noise. SyncStatusSynced IS exercised elsewhere in the same file, but only via the throttled-resume branch (_everPulledOnLaunch force-set by the throttle, not by a genuinely completed pull), so the 'real successful cold pull → synced' path this test is named for has no working assertion anywhere in the file.
recommendation: Either delete the test, or give it a gateway fake that lets pullOnLaunch complete successfully (mirroring _ProfileProgramsGateway in sync_rework_profile_programs_pull_test.dart) and assert `orchestrator.currentStatus is SyncStatusSynced` afterward.
acceptance_criteria: the 'empty outbox + online + after pull → synced' test contains at least one expect() against SyncStatus, or is removed
if kept, the pull it drives completes successfully (non-throttled) before the synced assertion

corrections: None — evidence fully verified as stated, no corrections needed.
